title: vitex integerrima
intro: Vitex integerrima, commonly known as West African privet or Vitex, is a flowering plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support menstrual health, reduce anxiety and stress, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Vitex integerrima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogen-modulating properties. While more research is needed to confirm its effects, Vitex integerrima has been traditionally used in folk medicine to support women's health and well-being.
